## Standardization

CORA continues the line initiated with **UNE 0074:2023** and provides experimental validation and technical development toward a complete standard. The recommended methodology and its technical basis are summarised in the [associated publication](https://www.scipedia.com/public/Serna_Moreno_et_al_2024a).
